title: Triangle Type
description:
Given the lengths of three sides of a triangle, return its type: `'Equilateral'` (all sides equal), `'Isosceles'` (exactly two sides equal), `'Scalene'` (all sides different). Return `'Invalid'` if the sides cannot form a valid triangle (the sum of any two sides must be greater than the third).

**Example:**
```
triangle_type(3, 3, 3) → 'Equilateral'
triangle_type(5, 5, 3) → 'Isosceles'
triangle_type(3, 4, 5) → 'Scalene'
triangle_type(1, 2, 10) → 'Invalid'
```
hint: First check the triangle inequality: a+b>c, b+c>a, a+c>b (and all sides > 0). Then check how many sides are equal.
